omni.description: The specific type of device, operating system, and browser used when this event was recorded (e.g., 'iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1'). Hidden by default.
The general type or brand of the device used when this event was recorded (e.g., 'iPhone', 'Android', 'iPad', 'Windows'). This is a simplified version of the 'Device' field. Hidden by default.
Additional details or properties associated with the specific event, if any.
A unique identifier for the individual event. Hidden by default.

omni.label: Session Event Num
omni.description: The sequential number of this event within the current user session (e.g., 1st event in session, 2nd event in session).
A sequential number for the event, potentially across all events for a user or globally. Refers to event_seq. Hidden by default.
The type of user interaction or system event recorded (e.g., 'Page View', 'Click', 'Form Submission', 'Meeting Booked').

unsupported.reason: dimension type location has no Omni equivalent

omni.description: The locale code (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR') representing the language and regional settings of the user's browser or device at the time of the event.
The geographic longitude of the event's origin. Hidden by default, used by 'map_location'.
The designated market area (DMA) or metro code associated with the event's location, if available.
Information about the network (e.g., ISP, organization) from which the event originated. Hidden by default.
The title of the web page on which the event occurred. Dashes ('—') are replaced with hyphens ('-') for consistency.
The number of full months between when this page (identified by its title) was first published/observed and when this specific event occurred on it.
The total number of 'Page View' events ever recorded for this specific page title (across all users and sessions) up to the latest data point. Calculated in the derived table.
The total number of unique users (blended_user_id) who have ever generated a 'Page View' event for this specific page title up to the latest data point. Calculated in the derived table.
The full URL of the web page on which the event occurred.
The hostname (e.g., 'www.example.com') of the web page on which the event occurred.
The path component (e.g., '/products/item123') of the web page URL on which the event occurred.
A predefined category assigned to the page where the event occurred, often based on URL structure or content type (e.g., '02: Blog', '08: Services').

fields.name: visit_value
fields.source_sql: case when ${is_conversion_event} then 16 else safe_cast(split(${TABLE}.page_category,":")[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] as int64) end

omni.sql: case when ${is_conversion_event} then 16 else safe_cast(split(${page_category},":")[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] as int64) end
omni.description: A numerical score assigned to the event. Conversion events ('Meeting Booked') receive a value of 16; other events are valued based on the numerical prefix of their page_category.
Indicates (Yes/No) if this event is a 'Meeting Booked' event, which is considered a primary conversion.
Indicates (Yes/No) if this event signifies the achievement of a predefined goal (based on the is_goal_achieved_event flag from the source table).
The postal or ZIP code associated with the event's location. Configured for US zipcode map layer.
The type of the event that occurred immediately prior to this one for the same user. Hidden by default.
The search query or keywords used by the visitor if they arrived from a search engine leading to this event or session. May be '(not provided)'. Hidden by default.
The unique identifier for the web session to which this event belongs.
The website or domain on which the event occurred (e.g., 'rittmananalytics.com').
A unique identifier for a user, potentially unified across different platforms or tracking mechanisms, associated with this event. Hidden by default.
The duration in seconds that the user spent on the page associated with this event before navigating away or triggering another event. Hidden by default.
The time zone of the user when the event occurred (e.g., 'America/New_York'). Hidden by default.
A user identifier, which might be specific to a certain platform or tracking system before blending (see blended_user_id).

omni.label: Event UTM Campaign
omni.description: The UTM campaign parameter value associated with the session or source that led to this event (e.g., 'summer_promo').

omni.label: Event UTM Content
omni.description: The UTM content parameter value associated with the session or source that led to this event, used to differentiate ads or links (e.g., 'banner_ad_1').

omni.label: Event UTM Medium
omni.description: The UTM medium parameter value associated with the session or source that led to this event (e.g., 'cpc', 'email', 'social').

omni.label: Event UTM Source
omni.description: The UTM source parameter value associated with the session or source that led to this event (e.g., 'google', 'facebook', 'newsletter').

omni.label: Event UTM Keyword
omni.description: The UTM term (keyword) parameter value associated with the session or source that led to this event, often used for paid search keywords.

omni.label: Anonymous (Device) ID
omni.description: An anonymous identifier, typically associated with a device or browser instance, used before a user is identified.
The primary key uniquely identifying each web event record.
A sequential number assigned to the event, potentially an overall sequence for the user or globally. This is the raw event_seq from the source.
Google Click Identifier (GCLID) captured for this event, used for tracking clicks from Google Ads.
The IP address from which the event originated. Note: IP addresses can be an approximation of location and may be anonymized.
The hostname (e.g., 'google.com') of the website that referred the user to the page where this event occurred, or to the start of the session.
The full URL of the page that linked the user to the website for this event or session, excluding any query parameters.

fields.name: referrer_source

omni.sql: case when ${referrer} like '%blog.rittmananalytics.com%' or ${referrer} like '%medium.com/mark-rittman%' then 'Medium' end

case when ${referrer_source} = 'Medium' and ${referrer_host} = 'blog.rittmananalytics.com' then split(${referrer},'/')[safe_offset(3)]
              when ${referrer_source} = 'Medium' and ${referrer_host} = 'medium.com' then split(${referrer},'/')[safe_offset(4)]
          end
